_comment: Declared identity of every imported verifier package and retained evidence
bundle. tools/ci/audit-evidence-integrity.sh checks HEAD against these values.
This file is the machine-readable form of the authentication PM performed by
hand for twenty rounds. Each tree hash below is attested in the cited document;
none was invented here. A git tree hash depends only on the entries it names, so
a subtree byte-identical to the verifier's publication has the same tree hash in
both repositories -- which is exactly what the cited dispositions assert.
Changing a value here is changing what the repository claims was imported. It is
Verification/PM's call, never a lead's convenience. CODEOWNERS covers this path.

spec_bundle.note: Canonical spec/*.md must match spec/VERSION.md, whose bundle revision must be one declared below with identical hashes. Every embedded copy of a frozen spec file under docs/ or tests/ must sit in a root listed in 'roots' and must hash to that root's declared revision; there is no global either-revision acceptance. These copies are authenticated historical baselines held in place by tamper controls VT8-A13 and PB8-A01; they are never rewritten or deduplicated against spec/. A new imported package or retained bundle carrying spec copies must add its root here with its explicit revision. Revision triples are PM-issued facts (#248).
